Reason: all 48 dataset V5 views exceed num_ctx/2 = 4096 estimated tokens (report 12 §7). The truncation guard stays at num_ctx/2 (now 8192). One condition for all views and formats.

what_you_see.V1: You will see only the public announcements of each round (announced action and message), not the final actions or payoffs.
what_you_see.V2: You will see only the final actions and payoffs of each round, not the announcements or messages.
what_you_see.V3: You will see each round's public announcements, followed by the final actions and payoffs.
what_you_see.V4: You will see a structured report computed by code from the public announcements, messages, final actions and payoffs.
what_you_see.V5: You will see each round's public announcements, final actions and payoffs, plus each player's private plan and private reasoning, which only that player saw.
